8. API reference¶

iLock_Geography This module contains a general framework for dealing with railyards having the IRailyard interface (as defined in Prover iLock).
iLock_Geography.builtins
iLock_Geography.geo_algorithms This package contains a number of modules that define the algorithms and functionality which gives more convenient access to the IRailyard data structure and its content.
iLock_Geography.geo_algorithms.area The module defines functions for creating and enlarging areas.
iLock_Geography.geo_algorithms.element The module defines utility functions for nodes, indices and objects.
iLock_Geography.geo_algorithms.pathgen The module defines classes used to generate 3-tuples (startNodeIndex, edgeSequence, endNodeIndex) for valid paths in railyard.
iLock_Geography.geo_algorithms.pathiter The module defines functions and classes that return different iterators over paths.
iLock_Geography.geo_algorithms.property The modules defines functions to check the properties e.g.
iLock_Geography.geo_algorithms.prot The module defines functions for finding protection objects.
iLock_Geography.geo_algorithms.railyard The module defines functions for manipulating railyard.
iLock_Geography.geo_algorithms.track The module defines functions for track circuits.
iLock_Geography.geo_attributes The module defines a number of extra geography attributes.
iLock_Geography.geo_predicate This module defines the class GeoPredicate, the root of the predicate classes defined in the submodules in predicate_library.
iLock_Geography.geo_render
iLock_Geography.geo_type The module consists of two classes, GeoType for modeling a base type, and CompoundGeoType for modeling a compound type.
iLock_Geography.geo_util The module defines utility classes and convenience functions.
iLock_Geography.geo2pispec The module defines the class PiSPECGenerator which is used to instantiate PiSPEC from geo types and populate PiSPEC parameters from geo predicates.
iLock_Geography.lcf.api
iLock_Geography.lcf.parse The module contains functions for parsing various LCF files.
iLock_Geography.lcf.table_methods This module provides builtin table methods and helpers for creating custom table methods.
iLock_Geography.node_types This module contains constructors for new node types.
iLock_Geography.pispec_configurator pispec_configurator.py
iLock_Geography.predicate_library This packages defines several predicate classes inheriting GeoPredicate that are grouped into different submodules according to the functionality.
iLock_Geography.predicate_library.area The module defines predicate classes that are used to populate geo predicates related to areas.
iLock_Geography.predicate_library.direction The module defines predicate classes that are used to populate geo predicates related to directions.
iLock_Geography.predicate_library.importer The module defines predicate classes that are used to populate geo predicates from configuration data.
iLock_Geography.predicate_library.internal The module defines several internal predicate classes that are for advanced users to extend the predicate library package.
iLock_Geography.predicate_library.path The module defines predicate classes that are used to populate geo predicates related to paths.
iLock_Geography.predicate_library.path_area The module defines predicate classes that are used to populate geo predicates related to both paths and areas.
iLock_Geography.predicate_library.position The module defines predicate classes that are used to populate geo predicates related to positions of objects.
iLock_Geography.predicate_library.protection The module defines predicate classes that are used to populate geo predicates related to protection objects.
iLock_Geography.predicate_library.relation The module defines predicate classes representing releations in the mathematical sense.
iLock_Geography.predicate_library.signal The module defines predicate classes that are used to populate geo predicates related to signals.
iLock_Geography.predicate_library.switch The module defines predicate classes that are used to populate geo predicates related to switches.
iLock_Geography.predicate_manager The module defines a container datatype PredicateManager, used to store instantiated predicates.
iLock_Geography.railyard_import The module defines functions for obtaining railyard objects.
iLock_Geography.switch_types This module contains functionality for replacing nodes with new nodes of the same degree as the old node.
iLock_Geography.type_manager The module defines the names of base and compound types for railyard components.
iLock_Geography.xconfig The module defines two convenience classes Geo and class:PiSPEC of which the combination can be used to either instantiate PiSPEC objects or populate PiSPEC parameters by PiSPECGenerator.
